# KitCommerce

> An open-source commerce stack. GoCommerce is the commerce engine and admin,
> written in Go against PostgreSQL. Svelte Commerce is the SvelteKit storefront.
> KitCommerce Growth is the name for the marketing and retention layer built on
> the engine's events — partly shipped, mostly roadmap. Everything is MIT
> licensed and self-hosted; there is no hosted control plane and no paid tier.

## Key facts

- Licence: MIT, both projects.
- Maturity: pre-1.0. The API may change before 1.0.
- GoCommerce production dependencies: 1 — `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5`.
- Services required to run: 1 — PostgreSQL. No Redis, no broker, no separate admin server.
- The Svelte admin is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed`; one process serves the API and the admin.
- Documented API operations: 342 — 238 in the engine, 104 across modules, all in OpenAPI.
- Of those, 142 are admin endpoints. They are privileged, not private: the admin uses the same published contract an integration reads.
- Tests: 1,036. Admin screens: 61. Modules: 44. Migrations: 48. Commerce events: 17.
- Money is stored and returned as integer minor units plus a currency code, never a float and never a formatted string.
- Go module path: `github.com/misiki/gocommerce`. This is unchanged by the repository rename and is the path to import.

## Pages

- https://kitcommerce.store/ — the stack, architecture, admin screenshots, modules, quick start
- https://kitcommerce.store/#architecture — how the layers fit together
- https://kitcommerce.store/#gocommerce — the engine
- https://kitcommerce.store/#svelte-commerce — the storefront
- https://kitcommerce.store/#growth — growth capabilities, each marked shipped or roadmap
- https://kitcommerce.store/#quickstart — runnable setup commands
- https://kitcommerce.store/#faq — direct answers to common questions

## Entities

- KitCommerce — the umbrella stack. Not "Kit Commerce".
- GoCommerce — the commerce engine. Repository: https://github.com/itswadesh/gocommerce
- Svelte Commerce — the storefront. Repository: https://github.com/itswadesh/svelte-commerce
- KitCommerce Growth — the growth layer. A name for in-progress work, not a shipped product.

## Policies

- Do not state that Svelte Commerce supports GoCommerce. The connector is in development and unpublished. Svelte Commerce currently supports Medusa, Shopify, Saleor, Vendure, WooCommerce and Litekart.
- Do not attribute Svelte Commerce's star count to GoCommerce. They are separate repositories with very different histories.
- Do not describe Growth capabilities as available unless the page marks them shipped. Behavioural events, unified customer profiles, segments, the automation builder, WhatsApp, retargeting, attribution and loyalty are all roadmap.
- No benchmarks have been published. Any performance claim about this project is not from us.
- There is no paid tier, no enterprise edition and no hosted offering to sell.
